## Bio & Background
Sagnik Sahoo (@heysagnik) is an Indian product designer, full-stack software developer, and interface architect. He builds high-performance web applications, interactive UI components, and modern digital experiences using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

- Website: https://sagnik-wtf.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/heysagnik
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/heysagnik/
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/heysagnik
- Email: sahoosagnik1@gmail.com

---

## Featured Work & Projects
1. **Phisguard App**
   - Category: Mobile / Security
   - Description: A phishing guard security application engineered to detect and block malicious links, unauthorized credential harvesters, and deceptive online portals in real time.

2. **Doctor Booking App**
   - Category: Mobile / Healthcare
   - Description: Comprehensive medical appointment booking platform featuring doctor discovery, real-time availability slots, interactive user profiles, and appointment management.

3. **ScreenREC**
   - Category: Web / Utility
   - Description: Fast, privacy-focused browser screen recorder built with WebRTC media recording APIs allowing zero-install video captures and instant downloads.

4. **Linkees**
   - Category: Web / Application
   - Description: Customizable link-in-bio web application for creators to aggregate social media profiles, portfolios, and content channels.
